description: A benefactor column baked into the built index for row-level READ authorization: the physical column that holds each row's benefactor id, together with the object type of that benefactor. Mirrors the runtime org.sagebionetworks.table.cluster.description.BenefactorDescription; the column name is the linkage to the physical index column and the type selects the ACL domain, so no source object reference is needed for authorization.

benefactorColumnName.description: The name of the physical index column holding the benefactor id.

benefactorType.description: The ObjectType of the benefactor (e.g. ENTITY), by enum name.
